scenario.title: Doctrine: Grace and Matter
scenario.premise: Across eight desks, build and question arguments about evil, freedom, bodies and grace. Manuscripts answer other manuscripts; agreement is not the same as victory. A completed argument reconstructs its author’s position, not a proof of belief.

stage.title: What does this wound tell us?
stage.speaker: Augustine’s handbook · North Africa, c. 421
stage.motivation: A wound heals. A friend is wronged. Neither case should disappear into a slogan. Begin with what each case shows; then ask how Augustine connects them to the claim that creation is good.
stage.travelText: What does this wound tell us?

things.label: A healed wound does not move into another body
The flesh remains; its healthy order is damaged
The wound heals; nothing evil leaves the patient
The clay remains; the jar no longer holds water
I take a friend’s share for my own comfort
Loving a lesser good against a better one
Is this wound an extra evil substance?
